subject: [RFC PATCH v2 04/18] mm: count the pages waiting for a grace period

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with the approach of exposing NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES and suggested using it instead of a folio-specific counter. Acked the patch.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch series proposes to count pages waiting for a grace period by introducing a new zone statistic, NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES. The goal is to improve memory accounting and allow for earlier freeing of pages that are holding back needed memory.
